fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Copied from the Task at proposal time so the reviewer reads the subject without a second query, and so the row still says what it meant if the Task is later renamed.

fields.label: Why
fields.description: The model's one-line justification. A duplicate flag with no reason is one the reviewer has to re-derive, which costs more than not flagging it.

fields.label: Not a Duplicate
fields.description: A reviewer ruled this Task is not a duplicate of the request. The row is kept, so the request still shows what the model claimed and who overruled it, but it leaves the review panel, the brief's not-in-scope list, and the duplicate scan of every later breakdown.
